task: Trace why a generic arithmetic function lacks a complete checked open summary.
observation: The compiler-owned inspect JSON identified the exact unavailable-summary gap as missing_typed_facts while exposing a concrete specialization with unresolved effects false; this separated missing expression facts from an effects failure without instrumenting compiler code.
impact: The typed projection made the summary failure category directly verifiable; source inspection was still needed to locate the absent arithmetic TypeRef and explain why the requirements were not emitted.

resolution.summary: The summary is incomplete because the returned arithmetic expression has no retained TypeRef; the API classifies this as missing_typed_facts.
